options.content:
# 三级页面点击到内容可见
固定清单：角色 `/chat/:id/voice/:id`、`/wishes/:id`；创作 `/create/studio/:id`、`/create/work/:id`、`/creation/characters/:id/edit`；个人中心 `/profile/recharge/:id`、`/profile/messages/:id`。主口径只用前台 SPA `page.navigation`，目标 ≤2000ms；N<100 延长窗口，无数据不补 0。

panels.title: 口径、层级与低样本边界

panels.description: 成功、前台 SPA 导航；按 route 与 Android/iOS 分列。

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, ${browser_selector:raw} |= "st_page_navigation" | logfmt | kind="measurement" | type="st_page_navigation" | app_name="st-miniapp" | app_environment="$environment" | app_version=~"$release" | context_measurement_version="engineering_v1" | context_outcome="ready" | context_visibility="foreground" | context_tg_platform=~"$tg_platform" | context_route=~"^(/chat/:id/voice/:id|/wishes/:id|/create/studio/:id|/create/work/:id|/creation/characters/:id/edit|/profile/recharge/:id|/profile/messages/:id)$" | context_route=~"^($entry_routes)$" | context_route=~"^($route)$" | unwrap duration_ms | __error__="" [$__range]) by (context_route, context_tg_platform)

panels.title: Navigation ready P95（目标 ≤2000ms）

panels.description: 同一批成功 page.navigation 的 duration_ms≤2000；失败/离页/stall 另列。

targets.expr: sum by (context_route, context_tg_platform) (count_over_time(${browser_selector:raw} |= "st_page_navigation" | logfmt | kind="measurement" | type="st_page_navigation" | app_environment="$environment" | app_version=~"$release" | context_measurement_version="engineering_v1" | context_outcome="ready" | context_visibility="foreground" | context_tg_platform=~"$tg_platform" | context_route=~"^(/chat/:id/voice/:id|/wishes/:id|/create/studio/:id|/create/work/:id|/creation/characters/:id/edit|/profile/recharge/:id|/profile/messages/:id)$" | context_route=~"^($entry_routes)$" | context_route=~"^($route)$" | duration_ms <= 2000 [$__range])) / sum by (context_route, context_tg_platform) (count_over_time(${browser_selector:raw} |= "st_page_navigation" | logfmt | kind="measurement" | type="st_page_navigation" | app_environment="$environment" | app_version=~"$release" | context_measurement_version="engineering_v1" | context_outcome="ready" | context_visibility="foreground" | context_tg_platform=~"$tg_platform" | context_route=~"^(/chat/:id/voice/:id|/wishes/:id|/create/studio/:id|/create/work/:id|/creation/characters/:id/edit|/profile/recharge/:id|/profile/messages/:id)$" | context_route=~"^($entry_routes)$" | context_route=~"^($route)$" [$__range]))

panels.title: 2秒内 ready 占比

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, ${browser_selector:raw} |= "st_page_navigation" | logfmt | kind="measurement" | type="st_page_navigation" | app_environment="$environment" | app_version=~"$release" | context_measurement_version="engineering_v1" | context_outcome="ready" | context_visibility="foreground" | context_tg_platform=~"$tg_platform" | context_route=~"^(/chat/:id/voice/:id|/wishes/:id|/create/studio/:id|/create/work/:id|/creation/characters/:id/edit|/profile/recharge/:id|/profile/messages/:id)$" | context_route=~"^($entry_routes)$" | context_route=~"^($route)$" | unwrap duration_ms | __error__="" [$__auto]) by (context_route, context_tg_platform)

panels.title: Navigation ready P95 趋势（2秒阈值）

panels.description: 每 route/platform N<100 时延长窗口，不判稳态。

targets.expr: sum by (context_route, context_tg_platform) (count_over_time(${browser_selector:raw} |= "st_page_navigation" | logfmt | kind="measurement" | type="st_page_navigation" | app_environment="$environment" | app_version=~"$release" | context_measurement_version="engineering_v1" | context_outcome="ready" | context_visibility="foreground" | context_tg_platform=~"$tg_platform" | context_route=~"^(/chat/:id/voice/:id|/wishes/:id|/create/studio/:id|/create/work/:id|/creation/characters/:id/edit|/profile/recharge/:id|/profile/messages/:id)$" | context_route=~"^($entry_routes)$" | context_route=~"^($route)$" [$__range]))

panels.title: 成功样本量 N

panels.description: ready/error/page_left/background 与 stalled 一起显示。

targets.expr: sum by (event_name, event_data_route, event_data_tg_platform, event_data_outcome) (count_over_time(${browser_selector:raw} |~ "st_page_(terminal|stall)" | logfmt | kind="event" | event_name=~"st_page_(terminal|stall)" | app_environment="$environment" | app_version=~"$release" | event_data_measurement_version="engineering_v1" | event_data_tg_platform=~"$tg_platform" | event_data_route=~"^(/chat/:id/voice/:id|/wishes/:id|/create/studio/:id|/create/work/:id|/creation/characters/:id/edit|/profile/recharge/:id|/profile/messages/:id)$" | event_data_route=~"^($entry_routes)$" | event_data_route=~"^($route)$" [$__auto]))

panels.title: 终态与 stall 分母

panels.description: 文档导航起点到 ready；不与 SPA navigation P95 混算。

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, ${browser_selector:raw} |= "st_page_launch" | logfmt | kind="measurement" | type="st_page_launch" | app_environment="$environment" | app_version=~"$release" | context_measurement_version="engineering_v1" | context_outcome="ready" | context_tg_platform=~"$tg_platform" | context_route=~"^(/chat/:id/voice/:id|/wishes/:id|/create/studio/:id|/create/work/:id|/creation/characters/:id/edit|/profile/recharge/:id|/profile/messages/:id)$" | context_route=~"^($entry_routes)$" | context_route=~"^($route)$" | unwrap duration_ms | __error__="" [$__auto]) by (context_route, context_tg_platform)

panels.title: 辅助：冷/直达 launch P95（不进入 SPA 主口径）

title: ST 三级页面点击到内容可见（2秒目标）
